bugs.summary: The new status pipe makes ManageTasksArgsSchema a morph that writes the piped status back onto the input object, so parsing the reactor's deep-frozen tool_call.arguments (any task carrying a status) throws instead of parsing.
bugs.evidence: src/agent/tasks.ts:11-14 adds `.pipe((s): TaskStatus => ...)` used by tasks/updates status (36, 41); src/agent/tasks.ts:121 `ManageTasksArgsSchema(rawArgs)` (parseManageTasksArgs, called from director.decide on reactor events) and :184 in the runner pass the raw object. Freezing is outside the diff (reactor snapshots). Fix PR #1091 wraps both calls in `cloneManageTasksInput(rawArgs)` (JSON clone) and adds tests that a deep-frozen create with status 'todo' or 'in_progress' no longer throws, plus a director.decide frozen-event test.
